9fc908566f73e830.job_title: Head Pastry Chef (Patisserie & Viennoiserie) – Luxury Café
9fc908566f73e830.description: We are currently seeking an experienced and visionary Head Pastry Chef to lead the pastry and bakery operations for a highly anticipated premium café concept in Al Khobar. This role is fundamental in shaping the identity of the venue through exceptional craftsmanship, precision, and innovation. We are looking for a leader who combines technical mastery with operational discipline and a refined creative vision. The Role As our Head Pastry Chef, you will oversee all pastry and bakery production, ensuring consistency, quality, and alignment with international luxury standards. You will lead the pastry team, manage daily operations, and contribute strategically to menu development, product innovation, and cost control. Your leadership will directly influence guest satisfaction and commercial performance. Your Profile Professional Experience Minimum 5–8 years of professional pastry experience, including at least 2–3 years in a leadership role within a premium patisserie, fine dining restaurant, or upscale café concept. Proven expertise in high-end pastry, viennoiserie, and baked goods, with strong attention to flavor balance, texture, and presentation. Experience managing production planning in a fast-paced, high-volume environment. Leadership & Team Development You lead and mentor your team with clarity, structure, and high-performance standards. You are confident in training, scheduling, and developing junior chefs while fostering a collaborative and disciplined kitchen culture. You maintain composure and authority during peak production periods. Menu Development & Brand Alignment You contribute to the creation and evolution of refined pastry and bakery menus aligned with the brand identity. You collaborate closely with senior culinary leadership on tastings, seasonal launches, and product innovation. You stay informed of international pastry trends and apply them thoughtfully to enhance the concept. Operational & Financial Acumen You actively manage food cost, portion control, and waste reduction to optimize profitability. You oversee inventory, supplier coordination, and purchasing to maintain ingredient quality and operational efficiency. You ensure production schedules are organized, structured, and aligned with daily business needs. Quality & Compliance You maintain meticulous attention to detail across flavor, texture, and visual presentation. You enforce strict adherence to food safety, hygiene, and local regulatory standards at all times. You ensure the pastry section consistently meets brand and operational expectations. What We Offer Staff discounts across the wider international hospitality group and sister companies. A very attractive reward scheme program. 2 days off per week + 30 days annual leave. Comprehensive medical insurance. A leadership role within an expanding international concept, with opportunities for future mobility and growth.

9f96c8a780a656f4.description: Job description Mace combines construction expertise with consultancy to unlock potential in every person or project and redefine the boundaries of ambition. Our values shape the way we consult and define the people we want to join us on our journey. The role: The MEA regional managing director will set the strategy and vision for Mace Consult across the Middle East and Africa, lead its delivery and be accountable for the region’s growth, commercial performance and people outcomes. The role will turn Mace Consult’s strategy into clear regional priorities, strengthen market positioning and priority client relationships and convert the region’s pipeline into sustainable and profitable growth. The MEA regional managing director will connect regional demand with Mace Consult’s global capability and build an effective, scalable organisation. Through clear business planning, disciplined cost management and robust performance insight, the role will strengthen decisions, productivity, predictability and control, while building the leadership, capability and operating model needed for future growth. Mace Consult delivers certainty to the world’s most impactful infrastructure and capital programmes. More than 6,000 professionals across six continents combine global expertise with local knowledge to help clients deliver on time, on budget and on scope. In the Middle East and Africa, our teams deliver programme and project management, PMO and planning, cost and commercial management, business advisory services, digital services and solutions, and responsible business across major infrastructure and capital programmes. You'll be responsible for: • Direct the Middle East and Africa strategy and business plan, aligning regional priorities with Mace Consult’s vision and growth ambitions. • Own the hub’s financial and operating performance, including revenue, profitability, working capital, cost effectiveness and key business outcomes. • Build a scalable regional operating model with clear accountabilities, effective planning and consistent controls. • Lead transformation and organisational change, translating strategy into clear action across the Middle East and Africa business. • Create a cohesive, high-performing leadership team and ensure the region has the capability, resource plans and talent pipeline to grow. • Drive market expansion by setting sector and service priorities and converting the regional pipeline into sustainable, profitable growth. • Lead strategic client relationships and act as executive sponsor for priority government, public and private sector accounts. • Connect regional demand with global capability to grow priority accounts, cross-sell services and capture new opportunities. • Represent Mace Consult with clients, partners and relevant government and regulatory stakeholders across the region. • Use financial, operational and market insight to strengthen forecasting, allocate resources and improve performance. • Champion digital tools, automation and technology where they improve productivity, quality, predictability and control. • Own regional governance, quality, audit and risk, while championing sustainability and the highest standards of health, safety and wellbeing. You'll need to have: You are an established executive leader who can grow and transform a complex, multi-country consultancy business. You combine regional market credibility with commercial discipline, strategic judgement and a clear record of turning plans into results, people into leaders and culture into performance. • A strong record of leading and growing a complex regional or multi-country business at executive level. • The organisational capability to build an effective operating model and align teams, services and resources behind growth. • Demonstrable ownership of full profit and loss, revenue growth, profitability, working capital and operational performance. • Executive presence and composure, with the credibility to influence boards, senior leaders, clients and external stakeholders. • Deep knowledge of construction and infrastructure consultancy, including programme management, project management or capital projects advisory. • Significant Middle East leadership experience, with strong knowledge of Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates and the ability to operate across the wider region. • A proven record of assessing markets, shaping growth strategy and winning and growing major government and private sector accounts. • Experience using financial, operational and market insight to set priorities and make clear investment and resource decisions. • Experience leading organisational and digital transformation and turning strategy into measurable results. • A collaborative enterprise mindset, connecting regional priorities with the wider Mace Consult strategy and global capability. • A skilled and inclusive people leader who builds strong leadership teams, develops talent and creates clear accountability. • A commitment to sustainability, safety, wellbeing, quality, governance, risk management, legal compliance and ethical leadership. This is an opportunity to lead Mace Consult in the Middle East and Africa at a defining point in its growth. To scale a successful regional business. To strengthen performance, delivery and capability. And to shape what comes next. Our values Safety first - Going home safe and well: We champion a safe, diverse, and inclusive working environment, understanding the importance of well-being in every team. Client focus - Deliver on our promise: We own the quality of deliverables and strategic outcomes and build long-term relationships with our clients. Integrity - Always do the right thing: We influence positive outcomes within our industry while always aligning with our compliance obligations. Create opportunity - For our people to excel: We champion a continuous improvement culture throughout all activities, inspiring our people and teams to develop. Mace is an inclusive employer and welcomes interest from a diverse range of candidates. Even if you feel you do not fulfill all the criteria, please apply, as you may still be the best candidate for this role or another role within our organisation. We are also open to discussing part-time, flexible, and hybrid working options if suitable within the role. #LI-On-site #LI-DP1 Preferred candidate Years of experience 8+ years Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

RSSE manages and operates a portfolio of sports, adventure, and leisure offerings, including water sports through Galaxea, adventure activities via Akun, and leisure experiences delivered by WAMA. RSSE also supports the partnership between Red Sea Global and the Saudi Olympic & Paralympic Committee, aligning with Saudi Vision 2030 to promote inclusive sports and recreational experiences. Role Summary The Warehouse Supervisor is responsible for overseeing the daily operations of the RSSE warehouse in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves ensuring the efficient receipt, storage, inventory control, and distribution of equipment, merchandise, consumables, and operational assets. The supervisor supports all RSSE operations, including watersports, diving, marine activities, recreation, and events, by maintaining accurate inventory records and ensuring equipment availability, safety, and operational readiness. The position requires 4-6 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Supervise daily warehouse activities, including receiving, storing, issuing, and transferring materials and equipment. Ensure all warehouse processes comply with company policies, safety requirements, and operational standards. Organize and maintain warehouse storage areas to maximize efficiency and accessibility. Monitor stock movements and ensure timely replenishment of critical inventory items. Coordinate the distribution and collection of equipment across RSSE operational sites. Maintain accurate inventory records and ensure stock levels are updated in relevant systems. Conduct regular cycle counts and inventory audits to ensure stock accuracy, investigating discrepancies and implementing corrective actions. Track the lifecycle of operational assets, equipment, uniforms, consumables, and spare parts. Monitor the issuance, return, and condition of sports, marine, diving, and recreational equipment, ensuring proper tagging, tracking, and storage. Coordinate repairs, servicing, and replacement of damaged or unserviceable items, maintaining records of maintenance schedules and equipment certifications. Team Leadership and Coordination Supervise warehouse assistants and storekeepers, allocating daily tasks and responsibilities. Provide training and guidance on warehouse procedures, inventory management, and safety standards. Ensure adherence to health, safety, and environmental regulations within warehouse operations. Work closely with Operations, Marine, Watersports, Diving, Recreation, Procurement, and Finance teams. Coordinate with vendors and suppliers regarding deliveries and inventory requirements. Support operational planning by ensuring equipment and materials are available to meet business needs. Reporting and Administration Prepare inventory reports, stock status updates, and warehouse performance reports. Monitor and report on key warehouse KPIs, including inventory accuracy and stock availability. Support procurement activities through stock monitoring and purchase requisition requests. Maintain accurate documentation for deliveries, transfers, inventory adjustments, and asset movements. Experience and Work Type This is a full-time position requiring 4-6 years of experience in warehouse supervision or a related field. The role is based in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia. Salary information will be disclosed during the recruitment process.

9fe9a35ca8ec72df.description: About the Role Fakeeh Care Group is seeking an experienced Echocardiography Technologist to join their team in Makkah and Jeddah. This full-time role involves conducting a variety of cardiac diagnostic procedures in both clinic and in-patient settings, serving patients of all sexes and nationalities with a strong emphasis on ethical and cultural sensitivity. The technologist will coordinate closely with cardiologists and specialists for supervision and reporting. Key Responsibilities Echocardiograms (TTE and TEE): Perform 2D echo Doppler studies on adult, pediatric, and neonatal patients, documenting preliminary results and notifying cardiologists of critical abnormalities. Prepare reports/videos for official reading, maintain equipment documentation, statistics, patient records, and ensure the examination room is clean and orderly. For TEE, prepare equipment, obtain consent, acquire patient history, provide patient education, monitor vital signs, and observe patients post-procedure. The role involves direct patient interaction across diverse demographics, necessitating a high degree of ethical and cultural sensitivity.

9f12f330eaf05975.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث جمعية البر الخيرية ببني كبير عن مساعد إداري للانضمام إلى فريقها في الباحة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى دعم العمليات الإدارية اليومية وضمان سير العمل بكفاءة وفعالية. يتطلب الدور متابعة تنفيذ القرارات الإدارية وتنظيم المراسلات والمواعيد، بالإضافة إلى تنسيق الاجتماعات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ التعليمات الإدارية الصادرة عن الرئيس المباشر ومتابعة تطبيق القرارات الإدارية. فرز وتوزيع البريد الورقي الوارد وفتح البريد الإلكتروني والرد عليه وفقاً لتوجيهات الرئيس المباشر. إنجاز أعمال الطباعة والرد على الاستفسارات والمكالمات الهاتفية الواردة. تنظيم وحفظ الملفات والمعاملات بطريقة تسهل الرجوع إليها عند الحاجة. تنسيق وتنظيم اجتماعات الرئيس المباشر واجتماعات موظفي الوحدة التنظيمية. المشاركة في الاجتماعات وتدوين وتوثيق محاضرها، بالإضافة إلى طباعة وتوزيع محاضر الاجتماعات الخاصة بالرئيس المباشر على الأطراف المعنية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال إداري ذي صلة. القدرة على تنظيم المهام وتحديد الأولويات بفعالية. مهارات تواصل كتابية وشفوية ممتازة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة الباحة. سيعمل المساعد الإداري ضمن فريق يدعم الأهداف الخيرية للجمعية، مما يتطلب الالتزام والدقة في إنجاز المهام. نظرة عامة على الوظيفة المسمى الوظيفي: مساعد إداري الشركة: جمعية البر الخيرية ببني كبير الموقع: الباحة نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل الخبرة المطلوبة: 0-1 سنة التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عمل جمعية البر الخيرية ببني كبير، يرجى التقديم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

9f3e108596527b9f.description: Overview Who We Are: Ever wonder who brings the entertainment to your flights? 9f3ecd7c5be17555.job_title: AM / DM - Hydraulic- Steel melting shop (SMS)
9f3ecd7c5be17555.description: Job Purpose The Incumbent is responsible for the maintenance, troubleshooting, reliability and performance improvement of hydraulic systems across an EAF-based Steel Melting Shop. The role involves preventive and breakdown maintenance, hydraulic equipment inspection, shutdown planning, spare parts management and coordination with SMS operations to ensure maximum equipment availability and safe plant operations. Key Responsibilities 1. Hydraulic System Maintenance Maintain hydraulic systems associated with the Electric Arc Furnace (EAF), Ladle Furnace (LF), Continuous Casting Machine (CCM) and other SMS equipment. Handle hydraulic power packs (HPUs), pumps, hydraulic motors, cylinders, directional control valves, pressure-control valves, proportional/servo valves and accumulators. Maintain hydraulic circuits used for furnace tilting, electrode lifting, roof movement and other mechanisms, wherever hydraulically operated. Inspect hydraulic pipelines, hoses, filters, oil coolers and lubrication systems. 2. Preventive and Breakdown Maintenance Prepare and execute preventive, predictive and condition-based maintenance schedules. Diagnose hydraulic failures, including pressure loss, oil leakage, overheating, abnormal noise and slow or erratic actuator movement. Carry out root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring hydraulic failures and implement corrective and preventive actions. Minimize equipment downtime and improve hydraulic system reliability and availability. 3. Hydraulic Oil and Contamination Control Monitor hydraulic oil quality, filtration, cleanliness and contamination levels. Ensure proper oil sampling, filtration, flushing and replacement as per equipment requirements. Monitor operating pressure, temperature, flow rate and other critical hydraulic parameters. 4. Shutdown Planning and Execution Plan and coordinate hydraulic maintenance during scheduled shutdowns and major overhauls. Coordinate with SMS operations, electrical maintenance, instrumentation and mechanical maintenance teams. Ensure timely completion of maintenance activities with minimum production interruption. 5. Spare Parts and Documentation Identify critical hydraulic spares and maintain optimum inventory levels. Coordinate with procurement for pumps, valves, seals, hoses and other hydraulic components. Maintain equipment history, breakdown reports, maintenance records and hydraulic system documentation. 6. Team Management and Safety Supervise hydraulic technicians, fitters and maintenance contractors. Allocate jobs, monitor maintenance quality and ensure timely execution. Follow plant safety procedures, lockout/tagout (LOTO), permit-to-work systems and safe isolation practices. Ensure compliance with standard operating procedures and housekeeping requirements. Desired Candidate Profile Qualification: B. Tech/Diploma-Mechanical (Full Time Regular) Experience- Post Experience 8+ Years

9fbf356c8aa70d1f.description: About Oumla Oumla is a blockchain technology company based in Riyadh. We build digital asset custody and capital markets infrastructure for banks, financial institutions and capital market entities in Saudi Arabia. We work as a technology provider: our clients' own licences carry each offering. About the Role You will own one of Oumla's core treasury and capital markets products, from discovery and product definition through to production. The product connects banks' treasury systems with market infrastructure, so that transactions settle through a shared ledger. This role sits between bank treasury desks and our engineering team. You bring the treasury view: how a transaction is priced, booked, settled and managed through its life. You turn that into product decisions, and you challenge our assumptions wherever they diverge from treasury practice. Responsibilities Product ownership Own the product roadmap, requirements and backlog, in line with company priorities set by the CEO and Head of Product. Write product requirements and user stories for each transaction flow, covering the full life cycle from execution to maturity, including margining, early termination and default handling. Define acceptance criteria with engineering and sign off on releases. Treasury and market expertise Validate product designs against real treasury, operations and settlement practice in Saudi banks. Translate Shariah-compliant structures and their documentation into product rules. Keep the team current on SAMA and CMA developments that affect treasury products and settlement. Integration and technical direction Lead the integration design between Oumla and treasury systems, the securities depository, the clearing house and payment rails. Define API requirements, event flows and data mappings with engineering, and review API documentation before it goes to partners. Coordinate testing and reconciliation with partner banks and market infrastructure. Partners and stakeholders Act as the day-to-day product contact for banks, market infrastructure and technology vendors in Riyadh. Run working sessions, prepare product materials and track actions to closure. Report progress, risks and decisions to the CEO and Head of Product. Required Qualifications At least five years in bank treasury, money markets or treasury operations, with direct exposure to fixed income and money market instruments, including sukuk. Experience in a Saudi bank is required. Working knowledge of Islamic finance structures used in treasury. At least three years in product management, product ownership or a business analyst role on financial systems, with a track record of shipping products used by institutions. Clear understanding of the trade life cycle: execution, booking, confirmation, settlement and post-trade. Professional fluency in Arabic and English, written and spoken. Based in Riyadh and able to work from the Oumla office and meet partners on site. Preferred Qualifications Hands-on experience with treasury and trading platforms, ideally on implementation or integration projects. Technical background in software, systems integration or data, enough to read API specifications, review event and message flows, and guide engineers on implementation choices. Familiarity with market infrastructure in Saudi Arabia, including the securities depository, central clearing and RTGS payments. Understanding of blockchain, tokenisation or distributed ledger concepts. Exposure to SAMA and CMA requirements for treasury products and capital markets. Relevant certifications, such as the ACI Dealing Certificate, CFA or a recognised Islamic finance qualification.

9f21cfbe5f8b475d.description: نظرة عامة على الوظيفة تبحث شركة الورق الصحي عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء، ترويج المنتجات، وإتمام عمليات البيع، بالإضافة إلى متابعة التحصيلات وإعداد التقارير الدورية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية بناء وتحديث قاعدة بيانات للعملاء الحاليين والمحتملين، تتضمن بياناتهم وعناوينهم وأرقام هواتفهم. التواصل مع العملاء وزيارتهم لترويج المنتجات (السلع والخدمات) وتقديم عروض البيع. عرض مواصفات المنتجات وميزاتها التنافسية للعملاء. التحقق من الأسعار ومنح الخصومات ضمن الصلاحيات المحددة. إتمام عمليات البيع وتحرير الفواتير وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة. تحصيل ديون العملاء وتسجيلها وتوثيقها، ثم توريدها إلى الدائرة المالية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو دور ذي صلة. القدرة على جمع البيانات والمواصفات المتعلقة بالمنتجات. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. القدرة على بناء علاقات مهنية مع العملاء. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض. تتطلب طبيعة العمل زيارات ميدانية للعملاء. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

9f3f1e328e16bbb9.description: About Al Qaryan Group Al Qaryan Group is seeking a Storekeeper to join their team in Makkah, with operations covering Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role is essential for managing the flow and storage of materials within the company's operations. Role Overview The Storekeeper is responsible for the comprehensive management of materials, spare parts, consumables, tools, and equipment. This includes receiving, inspecting, storing, and issuing items, while ensuring accurate inventory records and adherence to company safety and inventory control procedures. The role requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Receive materials, spare parts, consumables, tools, and equipment from suppliers. Verify received materials against Purchase Orders (PO), Delivery Notes, and specifications. Inspect quantities and physical condition of materials, reporting any shortages, damages, or discrepancies. Properly label, categorize, and store materials in designated locations. Issue materials against approved Material Requisitions / Issue Vouchers. Maintain accurate records of all incoming and outgoing materials. Update inventory transactions in ERP/SAP or other inventory management systems. Monitor minimum and maximum stock levels and report requirements for replenishment. Conduct periodic and annual physical inventory counts and reconcile discrepancies. Maintain proper bin cards, stock registers, GRNs, issue records, and inventory documentation. Ensure implementation of FIFO/FEFO principles wherever applicable. Coordinate with Procurement, Maintenance, Production, Finance, and other departments regarding material requirements. Maintain proper housekeeping and implement 5S standards within the store. Ensure materials are stored safely and efficiently to prevent damage, deterioration, or loss. Control access to store areas and safeguard company inventory. Identify slow-moving, obsolete, damaged, and excess stock and report it to management. Follow company HSE policies and procedures, including safe material handling. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly inventory/store reports as required. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in a storekeeping or inventory management role. Proficiency in inventory management systems such as ERP/SAP is preferred. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Ability to maintain accurate records and documentation. Knowledge of safety procedures for material handling. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Makkah, supporting operations across Jeddah and Makkah. The role involves working within a team to ensure efficient material flow and inventory control.

9f939ac8f290e347.description: About The Red Sea Landscape Nursery Botanica, a subsidiary of Red Sea Global, specializes in providing sustainable greenery across Red Sea Global’s destinations. Key responsibilities include operational planning, manpower and resource optimization, budget and cost control, landscape quality, plant health, irrigation performance, HSE compliance, client satisfaction, and contractor management. 9fbde8db3efbd11e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مدارس المنهاج الأهلية عن معلم ثانوي رياضيات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تدريس طلاب المرحلة الثانوية في مادة الرياضيات، مع التركيز على تطوير خطط الدروس وتقديم الدعم التعليمي الفردي والجماعي لتعزيز التنمية الأكاديمية للطلاب. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تطوير خطط الدروس بما يتوافق مع المنهج الدراسي والرؤية الأكاديمية للمدرسة، واختيار المصادر التعليمية، وتصميم المواد التعليمية والدروس. تدريس مادة الرياضيات للطلاب، وتقديم الدروس الفردية والجماعية، وتيسير المناقشات الصفية، وتعيين الواجبات، وتنظيم الأنشطة العملية والرحلات التعليمية. إدارة سلوك الطلاب وتفاعلاتهم داخل الفصل الدراسي لضمان بيئة تعليمية فعالة ومنظمة. تحديد أهداف تعلم واضحة، وإعداد الاختبارات والواجبات وإدارتها، وتصحيحها لتقييم تقدم الطلاب الأكاديمي. تقديم المشورة للطلاب وأولياء أمورهم لتحسين الأداء الأكاديمي والسلوكي، وتحديد الطلاب الذين يحتاجون إلى دعم إضافي وتحديد الطرق المناسبة لتلبية احتياجاتهم. تسجيل الحضور والدرجات وأداء الطلاب بشكل فردي وإعداد التقارير اللازمة، وحضور اجتماعات الموظفين والتنسيق مع الزملاء المدرسين والمسؤولين ومساعدي المدرسين. المؤهلات والمتطلبات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال تدريس الرياضيات للمرحلة الثانوية. القدرة على وضع خطط الدروس وتصميم المواد التعليمية. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والتفاعل مع الطلاب وأولياء الأمور. القدرة على إدارة الفصل الدراسي بفعالية. بيئة العمل يعمل المعلم ضمن بيئة مدرسية داعمة في الرياض، كجزء من فريق تعليمي ملتزم بتوفير تعليم عالي الجودة لطلاب المرحلة الثانوية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل. معلومات إضافية لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب لهذا الدور. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور في شركة مدارس المنهاج الأهلية.

9fc492f45d4de94f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة الذيابي للمقاولات عن مهندس زراعي للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة خصائص التربة الزراعية، وتصميم شبكات الري والصرف، وتحديد الآلات الزراعية المناسبة، وإعداد التقارير المتخصصة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة الخصائص الفيزيائية والكيميائية للتربة الزراعية ومكوناتها، ومتابعة فحص عينات النبات والتربة ومياه الري وتحليل نتائجها. دراسة واختبار أنواع الأسمدة المناسبة وتقييم مدى استجابة المزروعات لها. دراسة أنظمة الري واختيار الأنسب منها (كالري السطحي، بالرشاشات، المحوري، أو الموضعي)، وتصميم مخططات وشبكات الري والصرف الزراعي ومتابعة إجراءات التركيب. تقييم كفاءة أنظمة الري وتطويرها لتحسين الأداء. تحديد الآلات الزراعية المناسبة (مثل آلات الحراثة، الزراعة، الرش، الحصاد، جرش وخلط الحبوب)، وإعداد برامج تشغيلها وصيانتها، والتأكد من جاهزيتها للعمل. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال الزراعي. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بنتائج الأعمال، وعرضها وتوضيحها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة الزراعية. القدرة على دراسة خصائص التربة وتحديد مكوناتها. مهارات في تصميم وتطوير شبكات الري والصرف الزراعي. معرفة بالآلات الزراعية المختلفة وكيفية تشغيلها وصيانتها. متطلبات إضافية القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية المتخصصة. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتقييم البيانات والنتائج. الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة في العمل. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مجموعة الذيابي للمقاولات في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

9fdc8a8c4583ef2b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة عابد علي الحبشي للمقاولات عن مهندس كهربائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية، ومتابعة التنفيذ، وتشخيص الأعطال، وإعداد برامج الصيانة للأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية. نظرة عامة على المسؤوليات يتولى المهندس الكهربائي مسؤولية شاملة تشمل إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية لمشاريع الهندسة الكهربائية، ومتابعة مراحل التنفيذ. كما يشمل الدور إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات الكهربائية في المشاريع الصناعية، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص أعطال الأجهزة والمعدات الكهربائية ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والمعالجة. المهام الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية لمشاريع وأعمال الهندسة الكهربائية، ومتابعة التنفيذ. إعداد مخططات ومواصفات خطوط شبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية، وتحديد مساراتها. إعداد برامج تشغيل الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية بما يتوافق مع متطلبات العمل. تشخيص الأعطال في الأجهزة والمعدات الكهربائية، ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة والمعدات والشبكات الكهربائية بناءً على توصيات الشركة المصنعة والتعليمات المعتمدة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية. معرفة ببرامج تشغيل الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية. مهارات في تشخيص الأعطال ومتابعة إجراءات الصيانة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. سيعمل المهندس الكهربائي ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة عابد علي الحبشي للمقاولات، مما يوفر بيئة داعمة لتطوير المهارات المهنية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية التوظيف. نشجع المهندسين الكهربائيين حديثي التخرج أو ذوي الخبرة المحدودة على التقديم.

9fde6a765c4e6c82.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة كرم الوطن عن سائق شاحنة صغيرة للانضمام إلى فريقها في حفر الباطن، المنطقة الشرقية. يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. سيقوم شاغل الوظيفة بمسؤوليات القيادة والتشغيل الآمن للشاحنات الصغيرة، مع الالتزام بالمعايير والإجراءات المحددة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تشغيل وقيادة الشاحنات الثقيلة وفقاً لمسارات العمل المحددة وخطط العمل المتبعة. الالتزام التام بقواعد المرور والأمن والسلامة، مع الحرص على عدم ارتكاب أي مخالفات نظامية. إجراء فحوصات دورية على الشاحنة لضمان جاهزيتها، ومعالجة المشكلات البسيطة التي قد تطرأ عليها. رفع طلبات الصيانة اللازمة عند ملاحظة أي خلل يتطلب فحصاً من قبل الخبراء المختصين. الالتزام الكامل بأدلة الإجراءات، وأدلة المواصفات والمعايير، وسياسات وقواعد السلامة العامة المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات كسائق شاحنة صغيرة أو ما يعادلها. معرفة قوية بقواعد المرور وأنظمة السلامة على الطرق. القدرة على إجراء الفحوصات الأساسية للشاحنة وتحديد الأعطال البسيطة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قيادة ممتازة وسجل قيادة نظيف. الانتباه للتفاصيل والقدرة على الملاحظة الدقيقة. الالتزام بالتعليمات والإجراءات المحددة. مهارات تواصل أساسية لرفع تقارير الصيانة. بيئة العمل يعمل سائق الشاحنة الصغيرة بدوام كامل في المنطقة الشرقية، وتحديداً في حفر الباطن. تتطلب الوظيفة الالتزام بالجداول الزمنية المحددة والعمل ضمن فريق لدعم العمليات اللوجستية للشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. نشجع المتقدمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه على التقديم لهذه الفرصة في شركة كرم الوطن.

9ff45b5d0627771d.description: About Vanderlande and the Role Vanderlande is a leading provider of innovative solutions for airport logistics, specializing in baggage and cargo handling, high-end software for logistics digitalization, and extensive maintenance and services. The company serves renowned airports and airlines globally. This full-time position for a Quality Engineer - Mechanical is based in Jeddah, Makkah, and requires 5-10 years of experience. Role Purpose and Contribution The Quality Engineer - Mechanical will join the Quality Management team to ensure compliance with project quality plans and quality control documentation. This role involves developing and implementing quality control processes, managing documentation, and supporting the organizational quality management system. The position is critical for maintaining quality standards across projects and operations. Key Responsibilities Guide and control suppliers, subcontractors, and in-house teams to ensure adherence to project quality plans and documentation. Develop and implement project-related documentation, including Inspection and Test Plans, Records, Method Statements, and Supplier Quality Requirements. Prepare and submit technical documentation such as Inspection Requests (IR), Material Inspection Requests (MIR), supplier/subcontractor submittals, and End-Project Documentation. Plan and prepare internal project status meeting data to align with the planned project schedule. Assist in implementing the project quality plan and organizational quality management system, including procedure development, work instructions, and forms. Manage document and record control, nonconformity control, corrective actions, internal audits, and identify improvement opportunities. Conduct supplier audits, incoming inspections, in-process inspections, installation, and commissioning inspections, documenting results (FAT & SAT). Identify and address nonconformities and implement corrective actions. Prepare and deliver regular work reports and manage work schedules to meet project deadlines. Ensure regular updates of the quality inspection status overview and Global List of Open Points (GLOP). Follow up with subcontractors and relevant departments to close open snags and non-conformities. Identify improvement opportunities and propose solutions for change, applying standard quality control tools such as histograms, control charts, and Pareto analysis. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in a relevant quality engineering role. Comprehensive knowledge of quality fundamentals and the ability to communicate them effectively. Knowledge of ISO 9001:2015 is an advantage. Work Environment and Culture This role is a full-time position within Vanderlande's Quality Management team in Jeddah, Makkah. Vanderlande is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer, committed to considering qualified applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

9ff5d54fe9fa0aa3.description: About * Renal Care Saudi Arabia * Renal Care Saudi Arabia is a leader in the dialysis industry, committed to recognizing and celebrating the diversity within its workforce. The company focuses on recruiting top talent and fostering an inclusive work environment at all organizational levels. Role Overview The Infection Prevention and Control (IPC) role is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, requiring 2-5 years of experience. This position is responsible for preventing and reducing Healthcare-Associated Infections (HAIs) among patients, visitors, and staff. The IPC Practitioner coordinates the facility's Infection Prevention and Control Program in accordance with GDIPC/MOH requirements, accreditation standards, scientific references, internal policies, and approved governance structures. Key Responsibilities Develop, implement, and periodically review the IPC Program, annual plan, priorities, and policies based on Infection Control Risk Assessment (ICRA). Ensure compliance with Ministry of Health (MOH), General Department of Infection Prevention and Control (GDIPC), Weqaya, CBAHI, applicable international standards, and approved USRC policies. Conduct infection surveillance using approved methodologies and monitor dialysis-related infection indicators and transmission risks. Analyze surveillance and audit data, identify trends, and recommend performance improvement initiatives. Maintain IPC evidence files, surveillance records, audit schedules, committee reports, corrective action plans (CAPA), and closure evidence. Report IPC performance indicators, surveillance findings, and significant risks to the IPC Committee, QAPI, leadership, and regulatory authorities, including escalation when required. Report communicable diseases and notifiable events through approved MOH reporting channels. Conduct IPC audits, environmental rounds, and infection control risk assessments. Oversee infection prevention practices, including hand hygiene, PPE use, isolation precautions, sharps safety, waste management, environmental cleaning, disinfection, sterilization, safe injection practices, and dialysis station turnover practices. Oversee environmental hygiene activities and identify infection risks within clinical and support service areas, including kitchen environments. Investigate outbreaks, exposure incidents, and significant IPC risks, and coordinate corrective and preventive actions. Oversee staff screening, immunization, occupational exposure management, and post-exposure activities in collaboration with relevant stakeholders. Provide IPC orientation, education, consultation, and technical guidance to staff, patients, families, and multidisciplinary teams. Collaborate with medical, nursing, laboratory, housekeeping, biomedical, dietary, HR, and operational teams to support IPC activities and regulatory compliance. Ensure IPC responsibilities, protected time, and resources are appropriately documented and allocated in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements. Perform other duties related to the Infection Prevention and Control Program as assigned. Reporting Structure Solid Line – Head Nurse: Responsible for administrative matters, including attendance, leave, scheduling, timesheets, and daily administrative coordination. Dotted Line – Clinical Services Director: Responsible for functional oversight of the IPC program, including surveillance, audits, MOH reporting, training, technical guidance, and IPC performance evaluation. Medical Director: Provides clinical governance and escalation support as required. Position Specifics This is a full-time IPC assignment. The designated IPC Practitioner will be exclusively assigned to Infection Prevention and Control activities and will not be considered part of routine nursing staffing allocation or assigned routine patient care, dialysis, staffing coverage, or other non-IPC duties. Experience Required Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in Infection Prevention and Control.

9f1f8bf81396b441.description: About Westin Hotels & Resorts Westin Hotels & Resorts is dedicated to empowering guests to enhance their well-being while traveling, enabling them to be their best selves. The brand aims to be the preeminent wellness brand in hospitality, which requires passionate and engaged associates to bring its unique programming to life. Westin encourages its associates to embrace their own well-being practices both on and off property. Ideal candidates are passionate, active, optimistic, and adventurous, taking pride in maintaining their well-being. The Host/Hostess Role Westin Hotels & Resorts is seeking a Host/Hostess for a full-time position in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This role involves greeting guests, managing seating arrangements, and ensuring a positive dining experience. The Host/Hostess plays a key role in maintaining the cleanliness and organization of dining areas and upholding service standards. Capability to move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance. Adherence to all company safety and security policies and procedures. Reporting accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to management. Completion of safety training and certifications. Maintaining a clean and professional uniform and personal appearance. Maintaining confidentiality of proprietary information and protecting company assets. Work Environment This is a full-time position located in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role requires active participation in a team-oriented environment, contributing to a positive guest experience within the hotel's dining facilities. 9f07c6a57c3f76e8.description: About the Role The American International School Riyadh is seeking a licensed, full-time Elementary EAL (English as an Additional Language) Teacher for the 2026-2027 school year. This part-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and reports to the Elementary School Principal. The start date for this role is November 1, 2026. Candidates must meet the minimum criteria outlined to be considered. Purpose of the AIS-R Teacher The primary purpose of an AIS-R teacher is to facilitate learning, critical thinking, and caring among students. This involves cultivating inquisitive, independent, and resilient learners who are prepared to inspire positive change within their communities. Key Responsibilities and Expectations Design and deliver lessons, content, and materials aligned with AIS-R’s standard curriculums and teaching standards, utilizing various learning mediums. Demonstrate knowledge of student strengths, interests, motivations, and abilities to plan coherent instruction that supports learning and well-being. Maintain effective classroom control, organization, and management, including managing student behavior and monitoring progress. Create a respectful, student-centered environment conducive to developmentally appropriate learning. Plan and prepare coherent learning plans with clearly defined outcomes aligned with subject-level standards and benchmarks using the Understanding by Design framework. Gather, analyze, and utilize relevant data to measure and facilitate student academic progress, communicating learning targets and assessment criteria clearly.
